label: Ikony · Moonwalk (MJ)
desc: Přípravný krok doprostřed, klouzání dozadu, rychlá otočka, stoj na špičkách, švih boků, freeze v náklonu.
desc_en: A setup step to the center, gliding backwards, a quick spin, up on the toes, a hip snap, a freeze in a lean.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: the dancer lets go of anything they are holding, takes two steps away from the wall toward the center of the room and stops with feet together and flat on the floor, arms hanging loose, facing the camera
the dancer stands with knees loose and feet close together, weight rocking onto the toes, one shoulder dropping, and holds a cool relaxed stance

the dancer performs the moonwalk: one foot stays flat and slides straight backwards along the floor while the other foot rests on its toes with the heel raised, then they swap, so the body drifts backwards although the legs look like they are walking forward; arms swing loosely, and it ends with feet together
the dancer spins one full turn on the spot in one quick motion, arms tucked in, and comes all the way back around to face the camera again, stopping there
the dancer rises onto the tips of both toes with knees pressed together and body perfectly straight, holds the balance, then drops flat onto the feet
one hand lifts to the forehead as if shading the eyes while the hips snap sharply to one side and back, and ends with the hand still raised
the dancer leans the whole body forward at a steep angle with feet planted, arms straight at the sides, and freezes in the lean
